item.title: Onion Browser v3.4.1
item.description:
Onion Browser 3.4.1 | OnionBrowser
- Fixed IP leaks during DNS prefetch found by Mysk: https://mysk.blog/2026/08/04/webkit-proxy-icloud-private-relay-ip-leak/ (The other leaks are mitigated by Lockdown Mode in Onion Browser, included in Silver and Gold security levels.) - Updated libevent to 2.1.13. - Updated Japanese and Pashto translations.
